name: Cell Dissolve
description: Irregular cells, like cracked mud or soap foam, switch to the second clip one by one, with an optional bright border glowing along the cracks between them. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: cells
params.description: Number of cells across the height of the frame

params.name: smoothness
params.description: Duration of each cell's switch, as a part of the transition (0: each cell switches at once)

params.name: border
params.description: Width of the border along the cell edges, in frame heights (0: no border)

params.name: seed
params.description: Random seed: another value gives other cells, switching in another order
